tooltip.setpoint.handbook.more:
Right-click to read.
Craft another: book + copper ingot.
tooltip.setpoint.pipe: Connects tanks, pumps, valves and boilers.
tooltip.setpoint.pipe.more:
Longer runs mean more friction.
A run can be up to 512 pipes long.
tooltip.setpoint.tank.more:
Click with a bucket, or use the bucket slots.
Stack tanks to make one tall tank.
A comparator reads the level (0-15).
tooltip.setpoint.centrifugal_pump: Pumps from the tank behind it to the tank in front.
tooltip.setpoint.centrifugal_pump.more:
Uses 4 to 20 FE/t. A redstone signal stops it;
sneak-right-click to make it run on a signal instead.
Works with other mods' tanks too.
Starved, it cavitates and wears; an iron ingot fixes it.
tooltip.setpoint.control_valve: Throttles the flow in a pipe line.
tooltip.setpoint.control_valve.more:
Sneak-click: fail close (FC) or fail open (FO).
A redstone signal trips it to that position.
tooltip.setpoint.level_transmitter: Measures the level of the tank it sits on.
tooltip.setpoint.level_transmitter.more: Only needed when the controller stands elsewhere.
tooltip.setpoint.controller: Holds a tank or boiler level by moving a valve.
tooltip.setpoint.controller.more:
Place it against the tank: it links itself and holds 50 %.
Right-click for the faceplate.
tooltip.setpoint.field_communicator.more:
Sneak-click instruments to collect them,
then click a controller to link them.
tooltip.setpoint.stirling_engine.more:
Only burns while it has room for the power.
Powers every block it touches.
tooltip.setpoint.biogas_generator.more: Takes anything a composter takes, plus rotten flesh.
tooltip.setpoint.boiler: Turns water into steam for a turbine.
tooltip.setpoint.boiler.more:
A gas pipe on top takes its steam away; oxygen
piped in at the back makes the coal last 1.5x.
Heats to 100 °C, then makes 20 mB of steam per tick.
Steam builds pressure: built for 10 bar.
The burner trips below 10 % drum level
and at 9 bar. A comparator reads the drum level.
tooltip.setpoint.steam_turbine:
Makes up to 60 FE/t from a boiler next to it,
or from a steam line (a gas pipe).
tooltip.setpoint.steam_turbine.more:
Spins up to 3000 rpm with 6 bar of steam.
Three times the power per coal of a Stirling engine.
tooltip.setpoint.dcs_console: The control room for everything within 32 blocks.
tooltip.setpoint.dcs_console.more:
Overview, five-minute trends and an alarm list.
New alarms chime until you press ACK.
Right-click it with a P&ID to see it live.
tooltip.setpoint.hookonium_ore: A rare purple ore. Needs a diamond pickaxe.
tooltip.setpoint.deepslate_hookonium_ore: A rare purple ore. Needs a diamond pickaxe.
tooltip.setpoint.raw_hookonium: Smelt it into a Hookonium Ingot.
advancements.setpoint.root.title: Setpoint
advancements.setpoint.root.description: Process engineering, one block at a time. Read the handbook to begin.
advancements.setpoint.moving_water.title: Moving water
Starve a pump until it cavitates. Raise the source tank to stop it.
advancements.setpoint.hands_off.title: Hands off
advancements.setpoint.hands_off.descript: Let a DCS controller hold a level on its own.
advancements.setpoint.power_to_the_plant: Make your own power with a Stirling engine or a biogas generator.
advancements.setpoint.full_steam.title: Full steam
advancements.setpoint.full_steam.descrip: Spin a steam turbine up to full speed.
advancements.setpoint.mission_control.de: Build a DCS console for your control room.
advancements.setpoint.acknowledged.title: Acknowledged
advancements.setpoint.acknowledged.descr: Acknowledge an alarm in the control room.
advancements.setpoint.deep_purple.title: Deep purple
advancements.setpoint.deep_purple.descri: Find Raw Hookonium, deep below the Overworld.
tooltip.setpoint.hand_valve: Shuts a pipe line by hand.
tooltip.setpoint.hand_valve.more:
Right-click to open or shut it.
A redstone signal holds it shut.
The stem sticks out when it is open.
tooltip.setpoint.water_intake: Endless water from a river, lake or the sea.
tooltip.setpoint.water_intake.more:
Needs at least 2 water source blocks next to it.
Pipe it to a pump's suction.
tooltip.setpoint.pipe_wrench: Turns machines and cuts pipe joints.
tooltip.setpoint.pipe_wrench.more:
Click a pipe arm: cut or join that side.
Click a machine: turn it a quarter.
Sneak-click: pick it up.
advancements.setpoint.bottomless.title: Bottomless
advancements.setpoint.bottomless.descrip: Pump a bucket of water out of a river with a water intake.
advancements.setpoint.lockout.title: Lockout
advancements.setpoint.lockout.descriptio: Shut a hand valve to isolate a line.
tooltip.setpoint.pressure_transmitter: Measures the pressure in a boiler or gas cylinder.
tooltip.setpoint.pressure_transmitter.mo:
Place it against a boiler.
A controller against it holds the pressure
by turning the burner up and down.
Range: 0 to 15 bar.
tooltip.setpoint.pallet_truck: An electric pallet truck: moves pallets.
tooltip.setpoint.pallet_truck.more:
Right-click the ground to set it down.
Right-click it to take the tiller: it follows you.
Back it into a pallet to pick the pallet up.
CTRL: set the pallet down. Hold H: horn.
tooltip.setpoint.forklift: An electric forklift: lifts pallets up to six blocks high.
tooltip.setpoint.forklift.more:
Right-click the ground to set it down, right-click it to get in.
W/S: drive. A/D: steer (the rear wheels).
Arrow keys: forks up and down.
Forks in a pallet and up: it takes the pallet.
Down onto a floor or a shelf: it leaves it there.
Hold H: horn. Sneak: get out.
tooltip.setpoint.pallet: A wooden pallet for up to four drums, or one IBC.
tooltip.setpoint.pallet.more:
Two by two blocks. Right-click it with a drum
to load it; a green strap holds them together.
Or right-click an empty one with an IBC.
Sneak-right-click with an empty hand
to take the last one off.
tooltip.setpoint.drum: A steel drum: 4 buckets of any liquid.
tooltip.setpoint.drum.more:
A real one holds 200 kg; here 1 kg is 20 mB.
One and a half blocks high.
Break it and the liquid goes with it.
Works with buckets, pipes and pumps.
Right-click it with a dye to paint it.
tooltip.setpoint.ibc.more:
A real one holds 1000 kg; here 1 kg is 20 mB.
Two by two by two blocks: it reaches to your
left and away from you. Pipes fit on any side.
You see the liquid through the tote.
Break it and the liquid goes with it.
Black dye makes it black, white dye white.
It fits on a wooden pallet, for the
pallet truck and the forklift.
tooltip.setpoint.gas_pipe: Carries gas from high pressure to low.
tooltip.setpoint.gas_pipe.more:
Steel with a yellow band, like a real gas line.
It joins other gas pipes and gas connections,
never a liquid pipe or a tank. Gas flows by
itself towards lower pressure, to everything
on the line. The pipe wrench cuts a side.
tooltip.setpoint.electrolyser: Splits water into hydrogen and oxygen.
tooltip.setpoint.electrolyser.more:
Needs power (40 FE/t) and water: a pipe at
the back or below, or a bucket. Hydrogen comes
out on your left, oxygen on your right, two to
one, up to 10 bar. Oxygen with nowhere to go
is let into the air.
tooltip.setpoint.nitrogen_generator: Makes nitrogen out of the air.
tooltip.setpoint.nitrogen_generator.more:
Only needs power (20 FE/t). Two columns of
sieve hold the oxygen back, taking turns.
Nitrogen comes out on your left, up to 10 bar;
the rest of the air is blown off on the right.
tooltip.setpoint.compressor: Pushes gas up to a higher pressure, up to 200 bar.
tooltip.setpoint.compressor.more:
Like the pump: suction on the side that faced
you, discharge on the far side. It takes from
the fullest vessel on the suction line and fills
the emptiest on the discharge line. Denser gas
coming in moves faster; squeezing it harder
takes more power.
tooltip.setpoint.fuel_cell: Hydrogen and oxygen in, power and water out.
tooltip.setpoint.fuel_cell.more:
Hydrogen on your left, oxygen on your right.
Makes 24 FE/t for every block it touches, and
water for a pipe at the back or below: the
electrolyser the other way round. With the
gas sphere in between, it stores power.
tooltip.setpoint.ammonia_reactor.more:
Nitrogen on your left, hydrogen on your right,
one to three; ammonia out on top. Like the real
one it wants pressure: full speed with its feed
at 100 bar, slower below. Needs power.
tooltip.setpoint.fertilizer_mixer: Ammonia and bone meal make fertilizer.
tooltip.setpoint.fertilizer_mixer.more:
Ammonia on your left. Right-click with bone
meal to fill it, with an empty hand to take the
fertilizer out. Hoppers work too.
tooltip.setpoint.fertilizer: Grows every crop in a 3 x 3 up at once.
tooltip.setpoint.rack_upright: A blue post of pallet racking.
tooltip.setpoint.rack_upright.more:
Stack them as high as the rack, with two
blocks between them for each bay of pallets.
tooltip.setpoint.rack_beam: A level of pallet racking, for the forklift.
tooltip.setpoint.rack_beam.more:
Two orange beams with a wire deck, in the top
of the block. Lay them two by two between the
uprights: the forklift sets a pallet down on
them and takes it off again. Leave three blocks
between levels for a pallet with drums.
tooltip.setpoint.grating: A thin see-through floor for platforms.
tooltip.setpoint.grating.more:
Lies in the bottom or the top of the block,
by where you click, like a slab. In the top
of a block it makes a platform level with the
blocks around it, with room for a handrail.
tooltip.setpoint.handrail: A yellow handrail along the edge of a platform.
tooltip.setpoint.handrail.more:
Stands on the side you look towards. Place
another in the same block for a corner. Too
high to jump over.
tooltip.setpoint.caged_ladder: A steel ladder with a safety cage.
tooltip.setpoint.steel_beam: A column or a girder: it lies the way you place it.
tooltip.setpoint.checker_plate: Steel floor plate with a non-slip pattern.
tooltip.setpoint.hazard_stripes: Yellow and black, for edges and danger zones.
tooltip.setpoint.corrugated_steel: Cladding for the walls and roof of a plant hall.
tooltip.setpoint.industrial_lamp: A bulkhead light for walls and ceilings.
tooltip.setpoint.gas_sphere: Stores gas under pressure: up to 16 bar.
tooltip.setpoint.gas_sphere.more:
A round pressure vessel on eight columns, eight
by eight blocks and ten high: 220 B of room, so
3520 B of gas at 16 bar. It reaches four blocks to
your left, three to your right and eight away.
Gas pipes join the valve station at the front, the
block you place. Climb the caged ladder in the
corner and cross the bridge to the safety valves
on top. Break it and the gas goes with it.
tooltip.setpoint.gas_cylinder: Holds one gas, up to 200 bar.
tooltip.setpoint.gas_cylinder.more:
Gas pipes join it on top and on its sides. Its
shoulder shows the gas: red hydrogen, white
oxygen, black nitrogen, grey steam. A pressure
transmitter reads it, a safety valve protects it.
Break it and the gas goes with it.
tooltip.setpoint.floating_roof_tank: A huge round storage tank: 8000 buckets.
tooltip.setpoint.floating_roof_tank.more:
Eight blocks across and six high, built from
Hookonium steel. It reaches four blocks to your
left, three to your right and eight away from you.
The roof floats on the liquid: it rises and falls
with the level, and you can walk on it.
Climb the caged ladder in the front corner; the
rolling ladder takes you down to the roof and back.
Pipes fit on any of its blocks.
Break it and the liquid goes with it.
tooltip.setpoint.pid_board: Shows a P&ID on the wall, live.
tooltip.setpoint.pid_board.more:
Place boards side by side and below each other
for one big panel (up to 8 x 6).
Right-click it with a P&ID; sneak-right-click
with an empty hand to take it back.
Look at a symbol for its status; right-click it:
faceplate, or pump start / stop.
A comparator counts the alarms.
tooltip.setpoint.check_valve: Lets liquid through one way only.
tooltip.setpoint.check_valve.more:
Placed with its arrow the way you look.
Stops a line running back when a pump stops,
or a tank flowing back into another.
tooltip.setpoint.drain_valve: Lets a tank run out onto the ground.
tooltip.setpoint.drain_valve.more:
Place it on a tank. Right-click to open it,
or give it a redstone signal.
Drains 10 mB/t: a steady load for a controller.
tooltip.setpoint.safety_valve: Blows off steam before the boiler bursts.
tooltip.setpoint.safety_valve.more:
Place it on a boiler. It lifts at its set
pressure (10 bar) and shuts a bar lower.
Sneak-right-click: 6, 8 or 10 bar.
A comparator sees it lift.
tooltip.setpoint.flow_transmitter: Measures the flow in a pipe line.
tooltip.setpoint.flow_transmitter.more:
Put it in a line like a valve.
A controller against it holds the flow.
Range: 0 to 120 mB/t.
advancements.setpoint.skyscraper.title: Skyscraper
advancements.setpoint.skyscraper.descrip: Stack four tanks into one tall tank.
advancements.setpoint.steady_flow.title: Steady flow
advancements.setpoint.steady_flow.descri: Let a DCS controller hold a flow with a flow transmitter.
advancements.setpoint.good_neighbours.de: Pump into or out of another mod's tank.
tooltip.setpoint.blank_pid: Draws a P&ID of your plant.
tooltip.setpoint.blank_pid.more:
Right-click the ground: first corner.
Right-click the opposite corner: drawn,
ten blocks high. Uses up one sheet.
Sneak-right-click the air to start over.
tooltip.setpoint.pid.more:
Right-click to name it and read it.
Hover a symbol for its tag.
Put it in a DCS console to see it live.
advancements.setpoint.draftsman.title: Draftsman
advancements.setpoint.draftsman.descript: Draw a P&ID of your plant.
advancements.setpoint.mimic_panel.title: Mimic Panel
advancements.setpoint.mimic_panel.descri: Put a P&ID in a DCS console and watch your plant live.
advancements.setpoint.under_pressure.des: Let a pressure controller hold a boiler's pressure.
